metaDescription: RagaMuffin vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so RagaMuffin boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: The RagaMuffin core series (FVRCP plus rabies per law) is plotted at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks in the table above so a large kitten is covered as maternal antibodies fade.
At 10-20 lb (4.5-9 kg), RagaMuffin visit logistics matter as much as antigens: book the 16-week appointment before class, daycare, or boarding asks for proof.
Bring hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (hcm) risk and obesity into the RagaMuffin exam-room conversation while you are already there for shots.
Rabies for a RagaMuffin still follows local statute, and when the clinic allows you can pair it with the ≥16-week core finish, then photograph the certificate into PetClues the same day.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed RagaMuffin boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the kitten and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every RagaMuffin row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra FVRCP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed RagaMuffin item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next RagaMuffin kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new RagaMuffin due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the RagaMuffin core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my RagaMuffin misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read RagaMuffin health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the RagaMuffin adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (hcm) risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
